verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's agents get their own credentials through MCP using OAuth 2.1 instead of API keys (docs-7). Access can be scoped with roles down to the table and column (docs-24), and agents can run on isolated, read-only compute (docs-12). Together these suggest least-privilege access for agents, but no source explicitly ties the OAuth agent credential to role or scope restrictions, and API-key issuance is explicitly absent. missing for 10: documented per-agent scoped credential issuance (OAuth scopes or role binding for MCP tokens), scoped API keys or service-account tokens, documented expiry and revocation for agent credentials, independent or hands-on corroboration.
